outcome: In vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET)
cohort: Singleton pregnant women with Mullerian anomalies who delivered at the West China Second University Hospital between January 1, 2009 and December 31, 2020.
finding: Pregnancy with Mullerian anomalies is associated with significantly higher incidences of adverse perinatal complications, including preterm deliveries, PPROM, malpresentation, placental complications, uterine rupture, FGR, and low birth weight.
